meta.name: History & Warfare Now
meta.description:
Explore the universal drama of war: why leaders and soldiers pick up arms to fight, the technologies that have determined outcomes, the tragedies and triumphs of history’s great battles.

Shows: Megapolis: The Ancient World Revealed, Besieged Fortresses, Legendary Battles, Tombs of Egypt: Imhotep, The Pyramid Creator, Empire Builders: Mexico, Hidden Histories of WWII
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
